content: You wash the vessel clean a thousand times from outside, but leave the filth rotting within. How will the nectar stay pure?
author: Kabir
explanation: External grooming, ritual bathing, and public piety are useless if the interior heart remains stained with deceit, hatred, and pride.
practicalInsight: Cleanse your inner motive before taking any public action today. Ensure your intentions are transparent and pure.
reflectionPrompt: Am I focusing more on my public reputation or my private character?
